functions.name: shader

operation.ownership: No allocation, retention, device access or submission; all buffers caller-owned and disjoint. Failure leaves outputs unchanged.

functions.name: encode_draw

types.name: R4AmdShader
types.description: GFX902 wave64 native shader ABI. Code is immutable, 256-byte GPU aligned; no scratch, LDS or interpolated varyings in this renderer. Offline metadata originates in R4ACO; CPU encoding is not hardware admission.

types.name: R4AmdPipeline

fields.name: gb_addr_config
fields.description: Measured GFX9 GB_ADDR_CONFIG, identical to IMAGE_V1 architecture; determines raster tile-pipe walk fence.

types.description: Single-sample, one-color-target GFX9 pipeline. Hardware blend factors 0..10,13,14 (no dual-source export); combine 0 add/1 subtract/2 min/3 max/4 reverse-subtract. ROP is an eight-bit truth table. Compare/stencil operations follow Vulkan values. Primitive 0 point/1 line-list/2 line-strip/3 triangle-list/4 triangle-strip; polygon 0 point/1 line/2 fill. Cull front bit0/back bit1, front_face 0 CCW/1 CW. Depth range uses Vulkan 0..1; all floats finite.

types.name: R4AmdDepth
types.description: Retained separate depth and stencil planes, single sample/mip/layer. Depth format 0 none/1 D16/3 D32; optional stencil is S8. Addresses, sizes and epitches must originate in AddrLib. No HTILE or compression is enabled. Empty attachment has zero fields after size.

types.name: R4AmdDraw
types.description: Bounded direct draw. Descriptor table is 512 bytes (resource ABI2), push range 160 bytes. Index type 0 auto/1 uint16/2 uint32; index byte range covers first_index and count. Auto draws add first_vertex through native user SGPR6; indexed draws add base_vertex. Viewport and clipped scissor use the target coordinate system. Vertex pulling uses set0 binding2 with clip-space vec4 stride16.

types.name: R4AmdRect
types.description: Pixel rectangle in the image coordinate system.

types.name: R4AmdYuvPlane
types.description: Index into canonical native resource bindings; byte offset and pitch must match the referenced image plane. No CPU pointer or unretained GPU VA.

types.name: R4AmdYuvHeader
types.description: Native queue BACKEND_V1 profile revision1 command kind1: this 200-byte header followed by the common 256-byte color program and 48-byte YUV matrix (12 IEEE754 float32 bits), exactly504 bytes. Format1 NV12/2 P010/3 YUV420P, filter0 nearest/1 linear RGB after EOTF, blend0 replace/1 premultiplied over, opacity0..65535. Chroma origin uses float32 bits. Unused plane2 is zero. Driver binds its immutable ACO programs and retains all canonical mappings until actual completion.

types.description: IMAGE_V1 backend properties revision2. Retains the exact 64-byte revision1 architecture prefix, followed by bound native device facts. No Mesa structures, pointers, feature or Vulkan admission claims. Never manufacture facts for an absent backend.

types.name: R4AmdNativeSubmit
types.description: BACKEND_V1 native command revision1: 32-byte header then exactly ib_count R4AmdNativeIb records. Device facts revision2 flags bit0 admits PM4; 32+16*N bytes cannot collide with the legacy 504-byte YUV packet. The canonical submit retains every resident binding through actual completion. Each IB is inside a retained binding, VMID1. Provider preambles supply complete shader context; no embedded CPU pointers.
